bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to labor and industry; appropriating money for the loggers safety grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; LOGGERS SAFETY GRANT PROGRAM.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of labor and industry for the loggers safety grant program under Minnesota Laws 2021, First Special Session chapter 10, article 3, section 21.
additions: $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of labor and industry for the loggers safety grant program under Minnesota Laws 2021, First Special Session chapter 10, article 3, section 21.
